title: Aerospace - Nuts, Anchor, Self-Locking, Floating Two-Lug, with Counterbore With MJ Threads, Coated or Uncoated, Classification 1 100 MPa/235°C, 1 100 MPa/315°C and 1 100 MPa/425°C
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the dimensions for floating, two-lug counterbored anchor nuts, with MJ threads, coated or uncoated with a self-locking feature achieved by forming the upper portion out-of-round and with a classification of: — 1 100 MPa/235°C; or — 1 100MPa/315°C;or — 1 100 MPa/425°C.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Electroplated Coatings of Cadmium on Iron and Steel

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
